medium_checkpoint.decision: Meaning repair required: the old Chinese describes a fixed value, not standard vocal delivery. New 标准语音表达。 describes the usual vocal delivery without claiming a fixed value, price, date or invariant voice. Context is the unchanged medium expressiveness explanation.

changes.before_approved: 'auto'根据本设备当前空闲内存推导上限，机器繁忙时会自行收紧。'manual'则固定为下方的数值。
changes.after_authored: “自动”根据本设备当前空闲内存推导上限，机器繁忙时会自行收紧。“手动”则固定为下方的数值。
changes.backtranslation: Automatic derives a ceiling from the memory currently free on this device and tightens it when the machine is busy. Manual fixes it to the number below.
changes.english_source: 'auto' derives the ceiling from the memory this device has free right now, so it tightens on its own when the machine is busy. 'manual' pins it to the number below.

changes.before_approved: 选中'manual'时使用的上限。0表示改用自动上限，因此保持为0不会禁用防护。
changes.after_authored: 选中上方的“手动”时使用的上限。0表示改用自动上限，因此保持为0不会禁用防护。
changes.backtranslation: The ceiling used when Manual is selected above. Zero uses the automatic ceiling instead and never disables the protection.
changes.english_source: The ceiling when 'manual' is selected above. 0 means use the auto ceiling instead, so leaving this at 0 never disables the guard.

changes.before_approved: 需开启智能提示。固定一个环节；auto优先Radient。
changes.after_authored: 需开启智能提示。固定一个环节；“自动”优先选择Radient。
changes.backtranslation: Recommendations must be enabled. Pin one leg; Automatic prefers Radient.
changes.english_source: Needs recommendations on. Pin one leg; auto prefers Radient.

changes.before_approved: 使用哪种压缩机制。auto按模型选择。
changes.after_authored: 使用哪种压缩机制。“自动”按模型选择。
changes.backtranslation: Which compaction mechanism to use. Automatic selects by model.
changes.english_source: Which mechanism compacts. Auto picks per model.

changes.before_approved: 展开的工具行图标。auto读取终端模拟器的标记。
changes.after_authored: 展开的工具行图标。“自动”读取终端模拟器的标记。
changes.backtranslation: Expanded tool-row icons. Automatic reads the terminal emulator markers.
changes.english_source: Expanded tool-row icons. Auto reads the terminal emulator's markers.

changes.before_approved: `lop update`在此安装较新构建后，请本设备的mesh成员也移到该构建：一次一个、各自等待空闲、绝不强制。关：只有`lop network update`会滚动。未向本设备授予`update`的成员会被跳过，并附上在那里授予的补救办法。
changes.after_authored: `lop update`在此安装较新构建后，请本设备网状网络中的成员也移到该构建：一次一个、各自等待空闲、绝不强制。“关闭”：只有`lop network update`会滚动升级。未向本设备授予`update`的成员会被跳过，并提示需在该成员上授予此权限。
changes.backtranslation: After lop update installs a newer build here, ask members in this device’s mesh to move to that build one at a time, each waiting for idle, never forced. Off means only lop network update performs a rolling upgrade. Skip members that have not granted this device update, with guidance to grant that permission on the member.
changes.english_source: After `lop update` installs a newer build here, ask this device's mesh members to move to it: one at a time, each waiting for idle, never forced. Off: only `lop network update` rolls. A member that has not granted this device `update` is skipped, with the remedy to grant it there.

changes.before_approved: 'default'不发送任何内容（首选主机失败时，OpenRouter会切换到另一台主机）；'false'则宁可失败，也不切换到你的偏好之外的主机。
changes.after_authored: “默认”不发送任何内容（首选主机失败时，OpenRouter会切换到另一台主机）；“否”则宁可失败，也不切换到你的偏好之外的主机。
changes.backtranslation: Default sends nothing; OpenRouter switches hosts if the preferred one fails. No instead fails rather than switching to a host outside your preferences.
changes.english_source: 'default' sends nothing (OpenRouter falls through to another host when the preferred one fails); 'false' fails rather than fall through to a host outside your preferences.

changes.before_approved: 'deny'排除可能用你的提示词训练或留存的主机。'default'不发送偏好（OpenRouter默认：allow）。
changes.after_authored: “禁止”排除可能用你的提示词训练或留存提示词的主机。“默认”不发送偏好（OpenRouter默认：允许）。
changes.backtranslation: Disallow excludes hosts that might train on or retain your prompts. Default sends no preference; OpenRouter’s default is Allow.
changes.english_source: 'deny' excludes hosts that may train on or retain your prompts. 'default' sends no preference (OpenRouter's default: allow).

changes.before_approved: 'true'：仅限文本输出可被蒸馏的endpoint。'default'：不发送任何内容。
changes.after_authored: “是”：仅限文本输出可被蒸馏的endpoint。“默认”：不发送任何内容。
changes.backtranslation: Yes limits selection to endpoints whose text output may be distilled. Default sends nothing.
changes.english_source: 'true': restrict to endpoints whose text output may be distilled. 'default': nothing sent.

changes.before_approved: 'true'仅限支持你发送的每个参数（工具、结构化输出）的主机；'default'则任由OpenRouter静默丢弃不支持的参数。
changes.after_authored: “是”仅限支持你发送的每个参数（工具、结构化输出）的主机；“默认”则允许OpenRouter静默丢弃不支持的参数。
changes.backtranslation: Yes restricts to hosts supporting every parameter you send, including tools and structured output. Default allows OpenRouter to silently discard unsupported parameters.
changes.english_source: 'true' restricts to hosts that support every parameter you send (tools, structured output); 'default' lets OpenRouter silently drop unsupported ones.

changes.before_approved: OpenRouter如何为本次调用给主机排序。可能路由离开持有热提示词缓存的主机（长对话上会冷启动）；'default'完全不发送偏好。
changes.after_authored: OpenRouter如何为本次调用给主机排序。可能路由离开持有热提示词缓存的主机（长对话上会冷启动）；“默认”完全不发送偏好。
changes.backtranslation: How OpenRouter ranks hosts for this call. Routing may leave the host with your warm prompt cache, causing cold starts on long conversations. Default sends no preference.
changes.english_source: How OpenRouter ranks hosts for this call. May route away from the host holding your warm prompt cache (a cold start on long conversations); 'default' sends no preference at all.

changes.before_approved: 'true'：仅限零数据留存的endpoint。'default'：不发送任何内容。
changes.after_authored: “是”：仅限零数据留存的endpoint。“默认”：不发送任何内容。
changes.backtranslation: Yes restricts to zero-data-retention endpoints. Default sends nothing.
changes.english_source: 'true': restrict to zero-data-retention endpoints. 'default': nothing sent.

changes.before_approved: 'inherit'让智能体运行的命令看到你的环境（gh、aws、npm保持其令牌）。'allowlist'只传递PATH/HOME/SHELL/TERM/USER/LOGNAME，加上旁边这两个列表，因此本会话启动时用的提供商密钥不会交给模型编写的命令。每个会话只读取一次：修改后下次启动才生效。
changes.after_authored: “继承”让智能体运行的命令看到你的环境（gh、aws、npm保留其令牌）。“允许列表”只传递PATH/HOME/SHELL/TERM/USER/LOGNAME，加上旁边这两个列表，因此本会话启动时用的提供商密钥不会交给模型编写的命令。每个会话只读取一次：修改后下次启动才生效。
changes.backtranslation: Inherit exposes your environment to agent-run commands, retaining gh/aws/npm authentication tokens. Allowlist passes PATH/HOME/SHELL/TERM/USER/LOGNAME plus the two adjacent lists, so the session’s provider key is not passed to model-written commands. Read once per session; changes take effect at the next launch.
changes.english_source: 'inherit' lets a command the agent runs see your environment (gh, aws, npm keep their tokens). 'allowlist' passes only PATH/HOME/SHELL/TERM/USER/LOGNAME plus the two lists beside this, so the provider key this session launched with is not handed to a command the model writes. Read once per session: changing it takes effect at the next launch.

changes.before_approved: 留空则只有安全集。allowlist模式在安全集之外额外保留的名称——例如需要继续解析$(lop secret get NAME)的shell所用的LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIG_DIR，或LANG。inherit模式下无效。
changes.after_authored: 留空则只有安全集。“允许列表”模式在安全集之外额外保留的名称——例如需要继续解析$(lop secret get NAME)的命令行环境所用的LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIG_DIR，或LANG。“继承”模式下无效。
changes.backtranslation: Empty means only the safe set. Allowlist mode retains these names in addition to that set, such as LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIG_DIR for a shell environment that must resolve $(lop secret get NAME), or LANG. No effect in Inherit mode.
changes.english_source: Empty = the safe set alone. Names the allowlist mode keeps ON TOP of the safe set — e.g. LOCAL_OPERATOR_CONFIG_DIR for a shell that must still resolve $(lop secret get NAME), or LANG. Inert in inherit mode.

changes.before_approved: 听写如何移除语气词和非语音提示。auto在提供商支持时使用原生清理，否则使用保守的客户端规则；provider和client各自仅使用其中一种机制；off保留逐字转录。单次请求中的`cleanup`字段仍优先。
changes.after_authored: 听写如何移除语气词和非语音提示。“自动”在提供商支持时使用原生清理，否则使用保守的客户端规则；“提供商”和“客户端”各自仅使用其中一种机制；“关闭”保留逐字转录。单次请求中的`cleanup`字段仍优先。
changes.backtranslation: How dictation removes fillers and non-speech cues. Automatic uses native provider cleanup where available, otherwise conservative client rules. Provider and Client each use only one mechanism. Off retains verbatim transcription. The per-request cleanup field still takes priority.
changes.english_source: How dictation strips filler words and non-speech cues. auto uses the provider's native cleanup where available and the conservative client rules elsewhere; provider and client each use only one of the two mechanisms; off keeps the verbatim transcript. A per-request `cleanup` field still wins.

changes.before_approved: auto按智能体选择；固定值会覆盖分类器。
changes.after_authored: “自动”按智能体选择；固定值会覆盖分类器。
changes.backtranslation: Automatic selects per agent; a fixed value overrides the classifier.
changes.english_source: auto picks per agent; a fixed value overrides the classifier.
